Chongxiu Taiwan fuzhi (重修臺灣府志), the Fan Xian (范咸) recension
Date: 1747. NOT VERIFIED from a title page; conventional date for the Fan recension.

Transcription: Chinese Wikisource
https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/重修臺灣府志 (范志)
revision id 2621817 (2025-11-23T06:16:29Z) [391,006 chars]
Retrieved 2026-08-30.

In the 果之屬 (fruits) list, the tomato and its false friend stand side by side:
柑子蜜（形似柿，細如橘；和糖煮，作茶品） the tomato
番柿（形似柿，皮有毛；俗呼為毛柿。西域種） the velvet apple, NOT the tomato

The text also uses 柑仔蜜 elsewhere in a striking non-food context: betel-chewing
lime is dyed red with 孩兒茶 or 柑仔蜜 before being taken with betel.

CAUTION: this Wikisource text is in SIMPLIFIED characters, i.e. a modern typeset
edition, not a diplomatic transcription of the 1747 printing.
THIS IS A TRANSCRIPTION, NOT A FACSIMILE.
